The '''Vesperan Aristocracy''' was the noble and elite class of the [[Vesperan Empire]]. Aristocratic families supplied court officials, military officers, provincial administrators, patrons of the [[Imperial Cult]], and members of the wider imperial governing class.

The aristocracy helped translate imperial authority into local rule. In conquered and client territories, aristocratic networks supported occupation administrations, ceremonial loyalty, and economic extraction.

After the empire's collapse in 1949, surviving aristocratic families lost formal imperial authority, though some retained wealth, social influence, or loyalist connections in the postwar world.
